review.scope: Complete scene149 integration: pinned geometry-aware node loader, retained runtime owners and input handles, source color/texture identity, per-asset glTF source traversal, raw geometry attributes and indices, per-view uniforms, both PALs, actual GPU/input/attachment diagnostics, exact source/golden registration and documentation.
review.method: Three same-model subagents independently reviewed reuse, simplification and efficiency while the coordinator reviewed altitude using all four available slots. All findings lists completed before fixes. Supplemental independent passes covered the full cleanup/registration/provenance delta, collector order and native ownership, deferred failure and pure metadata fixes, and the final collector lifetime/parameter fixes. Each supplemental review recorded separate reuse, simplification, efficiency and altitude lists and read surrounding code. All findings were applied; final reviews are clear. After the first full sweep exposed six existing-scene color regressions, an independent audit covered all material color writers and a supplemental review covered the Babylon producer, gizmo/hover setters and shared bounding-box color ownership. Correctness and all four cleanup angles are clear after applying the shared projection cleanup.
review.correctness: Independent reviews and observing controls cover source evaluation order, getter count, owner/input/texture identities, synchronous throws versus asynchronous rejection at verified pinned wrapper boundaries, source traversal and Map insertion order, cloned mesh mapping, producer replacement/retirement, original raw attributes and source indices, actual PAL bindings and world bytes, canonical browser source integrity, pointer input and resized output. Signed-zero world residuals and upstream live-resize error84 remain explicit measurement limitations. The 664-test final merge check passes without skips. Batch audit confirms all completed prior scenes are already merged and all remaining agent work is included. Observing native controls now cover Babylon RGB copying from four-channel exports and gizmo registration/first hover. Both-backend targeted parity passes for scenes24,145,221,222,223,224 after these fixes; gates and goldens are unchanged.
review.validation: 2043 tests pass with zero failures/skips (108.944s). Full sweep passes all five stages for 278 native targets and 277 image gates in 266.052s; all reports are fresh and match current generated stamps. Neutrality covers 275 prior scenes: 262 bit-identical and 13 with previously measured backend variation, zero unexplained changes. Scene149 SDL full/foreground MAD 0.007478660300925848/0.008833991706463757; Dawn 0.00014214409722222167/0.00016790437397302697, each below the strict 0.02 gates. Current GPU receipts verify 855 draws and 570 exact raw geometry attribute/index transports on each backend, 79 material owners and the 65-source-texture partition. World matrices are numerically equal with signed-zero word residuals explicitly retained. All 22 full-viewport geometry output controls and all six input/resize phases with 42 displayed-tile comparisons pass MAD <0.5. Native orbit matches the actual browser camera; resize uses a fresh 960x600 browser startup because pinned live resize throws error84. Scene44 passes; its authorized exception is unused.

findings.summary: Share the existing retained_solid_texture adapter for source solid producers.
Share the glTF source-albedo schema key between packaging, native hydration and receipt diagnostics.
Combine duplicate reflective Object-call admission guards.
Derive local-attribute activation from the validated geometry variant instead of retaining a redundant row boolean.
Compute only the selected per-view node world matrix path.
Parse the source glTF factor once as doubles and allocate retained storage only when the public factor is present.
Use the existing array_from_iterable helper to evaluate collector producers once and keep their temporary alive through both typed sinks.
Project Babylon float diffuse colors from retained RGB through the shared project_material_source_colors helper, avoiding duplicate channel decoding.
